notes.title: Eat or DIE! Update Alpha 0.08
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793944/8d79487faaea56104211b57a5033e5777d11578c.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Now Fish are upgradeable! You can make your fish stronger with TBP which you earned or bought.
[*]You will get 5 TBP for each 3 stars you got from any map in game. (It is increased from 1 to 5.)
[*]New Map: Shallow Waters.
[*]UI Improvements have been made for Main Menu.
[*]The Latest Map you chose in Level Select Menu will be selected automatically after you opened Level Select Menu again.
[/list]



[b]UPGRADE YOUR FISH TO GET STRONGER![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793944/5b5f97b65ecdf88779878a5a746a21b6102b7cc7.png[/img]

tags.feature: Now Fish are upgradeable! You can make your fish stronger with TBP which you earned or bought.

tags.feature: UI Improvements have been made for Main Menu.
The Latest Map you chose in Level Select Menu will be selected automatically after you opened Level Select Menu again.

notes.title: Eat or DIE! Update Alpha 0.07
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793944/44fd196eae499fdd6612d952ff34271408f4802e.png[/img]

[list]
[*]A bomb which follows player and explodes when collided with player has been added to 3rd, 4th, 5th maps.
[*]Shark spawn has been added after 45 fish eaten for 4th and 5th maps.
[*]Restart option has been added to pause menu.
[*]A few smallest fish has been added before game starts to make things easier.

notes.title: EAT or DIE! Update Alpha 0.06
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793944/0ef3eee6653e7c775fb4868fd74b9a4baa09dec5.png[/img]



[list]
[*] Spawn rates of all maps have been changed.
[*] Spawn speed of the New World Map has been increased by 10%.
[*] An animation has added to bubbles which indicates health is increased when collected.
[*] Vivid color has been added for fish to separate fish that smaller and bigger than Player Fish.
[/list]

notes.title: Eat or DIE! Update Alpha 0.05
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793944/700a047c9f7721fb64d65b4929e467946fd3f740.png[/img]


[list]
[*]  Endless Mode bugs have been fixed.
[*]  New World Map bugs have been fixed.
[*]  Bubbles will increase your health by random range between 1 to 4 health points when collected.
[*]  Some Changes have been made for the UI.
[*]  Background of the endless map have been changed.
[*]  Player's speed in Endless mode have been increased by 40%.
[*]  4k and 2k resolutions have been added.
[*]  Vsync Option added.
[/list]

tags.bug: Endless Mode bugs have been fixed.
New World Map bugs have been fixed.

tags.balance_change: Bubbles will increase your health by random range between 1 to 4 health points when collected.
Player's speed in Endless mode have been increased by 40%.

notes.title: Eat or DIE! Update Alpha 0.04 Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38793944/eb79080a453c66429da892dcd3495cad43d573e1.png[/img]

[b]Hello Dear Eat or DIE! Gamers, [/b]

[list]
[*] We were aware of a bug about that The Big Points are not added after you bought DLC. Today we fixed that bug and now the points which you bought will be added to your in-game balance after you started game. We are very sorry about that bug, but in the meantime happy to fix it! Happy New Year!
[/list]

tags.bug: We were aware of a bug about that The Big Points are not added after you bought DLC. Today we fixed that bug and now the points which you bought will be added to your in-game balance after you started game.

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.04
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Update Alpha 0.04 Changelog[/b][/u][/h1]


[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38793944/aa5fd7726cd130935b73362b19b3c9027189ae94.png[/img]

[i][b][list]
[*] Added 4 new controllable fish.(Purchasable by in-game money.)
[*] Added In-game Money.(The Big Points)
[*] In-game Money Can be earned by getting 3 stars.
[*] Fixed Minor Bugs.
[*] In-game Money will be purchasable after 2-4 days when this update is released.
[/list][/b][/i]
